description.value: Rainbow Lanes is a 16-lane, five-pin bowling alley and lounge in the heart of Port Alberni that has operated from the same address for over 65 years. It runs multiple leagues catering to bowlers of various ages and skill levels, from senior afternoon leagues to evening sessions, and also offers pinball machines for a retro entertainment experience. A touring cyclist rolling through Port Alberni will find a well-established community gathering spot with a lounge on site.
